attrs.remaining_trust: That the materials on disk are the artifacts the review read. Their sha256 is verified against the manifest, and a file whose name matches while its bytes do not is refused rather than used — but content addressing establishes WHICH bytes were read, never THAT they were read. Where the materials are absent the derived checks report NOT STATED and the count of unstated checks is printed.
attrs.rule: complete enumeration of a finite domain RECOMPUTED from content-addressed inputs, rather than declared by the document under test
